function s15ObbHit(A,B){const [ax,ay,ah,al,aw]=A,[bx,by,bh,bl,bw]=B;if(Math.hypot(ax-bx,ay-by)>Math.hypot(al,aw)+Math.hypot(bl,bw))return false;for(const h of [ah,ah+Math.PI/2,bh,bh+Math.PI/2]){const c=Math.cos(h),s=Math.sin(h);
 const pr=(x,y,hh,l,w)=>{const p=x*c+y*s,r=Math.abs(l*(Math.cos(hh)*c+Math.sin(hh)*s))+Math.abs(w*(-Math.sin(hh)*c+Math.cos(hh)*s));return[p-r,p+r]};const [a0,a1]=pr(ax,ay,ah,al,aw),[b0,b1]=pr(bx,by,bh,bl,bw);if(a1<b0||b1<a0)return false}return true}
function s15Boxes(a,P){const [x,y,h,z]=P,c=Math.cos(h),s=Math.sin(h);if(a.kind==='ac'){if(z>30)return[];const ng=(S15SIM.ngf[a.model]||.12)*a.L;return[[x-c*(a.L/2-ng),y-s*(a.L/2-ng),h,a.L/2,a.L*.055+4],[x-c*(a.L*.45-ng),y-s*(a.L*.45-ng),h,a.L*.09,a.W/2]]}return[[x,y,h,a.L/2,a.W/2]]}
function s15SimAudit(dt=1){const T=S15SIM.T,issues=[],ALL=[...S15SIM.flights,...S15SIM.veh],R=S15D.rwy,RB=[(R[0]+R[2])/2,(R[1]+R[3])/2,0,(R[2]-R[0])/2,(R[3]-R[1])/2],act=new Set(S15SIM.sched.map(q=>q[0]));
 const PK=[];for(const [sid,ac] of Object.entries(S15D.parked)){if(!ac||act.has(sid))continue;const s=S15D.stands[sid],L=({'AC-LG-01':668,'AC-NB-01':376,'AC-RJ-01':317,'AC-CG-01':549,'AC-TB-01':120,'AC-LT-01':91,'AC-PR-01':83,'AC-BJ-01':144,'AC-CN-01':144})[ac]||300,Sp=({'AC-LG-01':648,'AC-NB-01':358,'AC-RJ-01':260,'AC-CG-01':476,'AC-TB-01':200,'AC-LT-01':112,'AC-PR-01':110,'AC-BJ-01':158,'AC-CN-01':140})[ac]||300;
  PK.push({id:'PK-'+sid,kind:'ac',model:ac,L,W:Sp,P:[s.cx,s.nose-(S15SIM.ngf[ac]||.12)*L,Math.PI/2,0]})}
 let pairs=0,ends=0;for(let t=0;t<T;t+=dt){const P=[];for(const a of ALL){const q=s15PoseAt(a,t);if(!q)continue;if(a.kind==='veh'&&q[4]===16)continue;const B=s15Boxes(a,q);if(a.kind==='veh'&&B.some(b=>s15ObbHit(b,RB)))issues.push(t+': '+a.id+' על המסלול');P.push([a,B,q])}
  for(const p of PK)P.push([p,s15Boxes(p,p.P),p.P]);
  for(let i=0;i<P.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<P.length;j++){const [a,A,qa]=P[i],[b,B,qb]=P[j];if(a.kind==='veh'&&b.kind==='veh'&&a.home===b.home&&qa[4]===0&&qb[4]===0)continue;pairs++;if(A.some(x=>B.some(y=>s15ObbHit(x,y)))){issues.push(t+': '+a.id+' × '+b.id);if(issues.length>30)return{ok:false,issues,pairs}}}}
 for(const a of S15SIM.flights){const xs=a.legs.flatMap(g=>g.p.map(p=>p[0]));if(Math.min(...xs)<0&&Math.max(...xs)>9600)ends++}
 return{ok:!issues.length&&ends===S15SIM.flights.length,issues,pairs,cycles:ends}}
 
function s15VinvAudit(){const T=S15SIM.T,dt=.5,issues=[];let a=0;
 for(const v of S15SIM.veh){let p=null;for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=dt){const q=s15PoseAt(v,t%T);if(!q){issues.push(v.id+' לא מצויר ב-'+t);break}if(p){const d=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]);if(d>90){issues.push(v.id+' קופץ '+Math.round(d)+' ב-'+t);break}}p=q}}
 for(const f of S15SIM.flights){a++;let p=null;for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=dt){const q=s15PoseAt(f,t%T);if(!!q!==!!p&&t>0){const r=q||p;if(r[0]>=0&&r[0]<=9600){issues.push(f.id+(q?' מופיע':' נעלם')+' ב-'+Math.round(r[0])+','+Math.round(r[1]));break}}if(q&&p){const d=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]);if(d>420){issues.push(f.id+' קופץ '+Math.round(d));break}}p=q}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,n:S15SIM.veh.length,a}}


function s15CycleAudit(dt=.1){const R=S15D.rwy,RC=S15D.rcy,TY=S15D.tacy,issues=[],per=[];let W={rwy:0,air:0,twa:0,turn:0,jump:0};
 for(const a of S15SIM.flights){const L=a.legs.filter(g=>!g.att);if(!L.length)continue;const t0=L[0].t0,t1=L[L.length-1].t1;
  let p=null,acc=0,sg=0,sd=0,mx=0,mxAt=null,dR=0,dAir=0,dA=0,lift=null,jump=0,west=0;
  for(let t=t0;t<=t1+1e-9;t+=dt){let q=null;for(const g of L)if(t>=g.t0-1e-6&&t<=g.t1+1e-6){q=s15PoseLeg(g,t);break}if(!q){p=null;continue}
   const [x,y,h,z]=q,inR=z<=2&&x>=R[0]&&x<=R[2]&&y>=R[1]&&y<=R[3],st=Math.abs(Math.sin(h))<.035;
   if(p){const ds=Math.hypot(x-p[0],y-p[1]),v=ds/dt,dh=Math.atan2(Math.sin(h-p[2]),Math.cos(h-p[2]));
    if(v>.5){if(Math.abs(dh)>Math.PI/6)jump=Math.max(jump,Math.abs(dh));
     if(Math.abs(dh)<1e-4){sd+=ds;if(sd>40){acc=0;sg=0}}else{const s=Math.sign(dh);if(s!==sg){acc=0;sg=s}acc+=dh;sd=0;if(Math.abs(acc)>mx){mx=Math.abs(acc);mxAt=[Math.round(x),Math.round(y)]}}
     if(inR&&st&&v>30){dR=Math.max(dR,Math.abs(y-RC));if(Math.cos(h)<0)west++}
     if(!inR&&z<=2&&st&&v>5&&Math.abs(y-TY)<60&&x>R[0]&&x<R[2])dA=Math.max(dA,Math.abs(y-TY))}
    if(z>2&&z<=600&&x>-200&&x<9800)dAir=Math.max(dAir,Math.abs(y-RC));
    if(p[3]<=2&&z>2&&lift==null)lift=[Math.round(x),Math.round(y-RC)]}
   p=[x,y,h,z]}
  const T=Math.round(mx*180/Math.PI),J=Math.round(jump*180/Math.PI);per.push({id:a.id,ac:a.model,rwy:+dR.toFixed(1),air:+dAir.toFixed(1),twa:+dA.toFixed(1),lift,turn:T,turnAt:mxAt,jump:J,west});
  W.rwy=Math.max(W.rwy,dR);W.air=Math.max(W.air,dAir);W.twa=Math.max(W.twa,dA);W.turn=Math.max(W.turn,T);W.jump=Math.max(W.jump,J);
  if(dR>3)issues.push(a.id+' סוטה '+dR.toFixed(1)+' פיקס׳ מהקו האמצעי בגלגול');if(dAir>3)issues.push(a.id+' סוטה '+dAir.toFixed(1)+' באוויר');if(!lift||Math.abs(lift[1])>3)issues.push(a.id+' מתנתק '+(lift?lift[1]+' פיקס׳ מהקו האמצעי':'— אין המראה'));
  if(west)issues.push(a.id+' נוסע על המסלול מערבה ('+west+' דגימות)');if(T>185)issues.push(a.id+' מסתובב '+T+'° ברצף ב-'+mxAt);if(J>0)issues.push(a.id+' האף מתהפך '+J+'° בבת אחת');if(dA>3)issues.push(a.id+' סוטה '+dA.toFixed(1)+' מהקו של A')}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,worst:{rwy:+W.rwy.toFixed(1),air:+W.air.toFixed(1),twa:+W.twa.toFixed(1),turn:W.turn,jump:W.jump},per}}

function s15FlightTimes(){if(S15_FT)return S15_FT;const R=S15D.rwy,T=S15SIM.T,out=[];
 for(const a of S15SIM.flights){const L=a.legs.filter(g=>!g.att);let st=null;for(const g of L)if(g.h!=null&&g.f===0&&(!st||g.t1-g.t0>st.t1-st.t0))st=g;
  
  let land=null,off=null,pz=null;for(let t=L[0].t0;t<=L[L.length-1].t1;t+=.25){let q=null;for(const g of L)if(t>=g.t0&&t<=g.t1){q=s15PoseLeg(g,t);break}if(!q){pz=null;continue}if(pz!=null){if(pz>2&&q[3]<=2&&land==null)land=t;if(pz<=2&&q[3]>2&&off==null)off=t}pz=q[3]}

function s15grTrain(v,tc,Lt,P0){const P=s15grPath(v),dt=P.dt,N=P.N,i0=N+Math.floor(tc/dt),f=tc/dt-Math.floor(tc/dt),s0=P.S[i0]+(P.S[Math.min(i0+1,2*N)]-P.S[i0])*f,C=S15GR_CART,Lc=C.L*S15GR.PX*S15GR.VK,g=C.gap*S15GR.PX,out=[];
 
 for(let k=0;k<C.n;k++){const sm=s0-(Lt/2+g+Lc/2+k*(Lc+g)),a=s15grAt(P,sm+Lc/2),b=s15grAt(P,sm-Lc/2);let th=Math.atan2(a[1]-b[1],a[0]-b[0]);
  if(!(Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])>Lc*.5))th=k?out[k-1][2]:P0[2];out.push([(a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2,th])}

function s15kProfile(P,vmax,vs,ve,rev){if(rev)vmax=Math.min(vmax,S15K_REV);vs=Math.min(vs,vmax);ve=Math.min(ve,vmax);
 const n=P.length,S=[0];for(let i=1;i<n;i++)S.push(S[i-1]+Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]));const L=S[n-1];if(L<1)return null;
 const cap=new Array(n).fill(vmax);cap[0]=vs;cap[n-1]=ve;
 for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){const a=Math.atan2(P[i][1]-P[i-1][1],P[i][0]-P[i-1][0]),b=Math.atan2(P[i+1][1]-P[i][1],P[i+1][0]-P[i][0]);let d=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(b-a),Math.cos(b-a)));
  if(d<.02)continue;const l=Math.min(S[i]-S[i-1],S[i+1]-S[i]),r=l/(2*Math.tan(d/2)||1e-6);cap[i]=d>.87?Math.min(cap[i],6):r<80?Math.min(cap[i],Math.max(8,Math.min(S15K_ARC,Math.sqrt(1.6*10*r)))):cap[i]}
 
 for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){if(cap[i]>=vmax)continue;let j=i;while(j+1<n-1&&cap[j+1]<vmax&&cap[j+1]>6&&cap[i]>6)j++;let m=Infinity;for(let k=i;k<=j;k++)m=Math.min(m,cap[k]);m=Math.max(6,Math.floor(m/3)*3);for(let k=i;k<=j;k++)cap[k]=Math.min(cap[k],m)<=6?Math.min(cap[k],6):m;i=j}
 const v=cap.slice();for(let i=1;i<n;i++)v[i]=Math.min(v[i],Math.sqrt(v[i-1]*v[i-1]+2*S15K_ACC*(S[i]-S[i-1])));for(let i=n-2;i>=0;i--)v[i]=Math.min(v[i],Math.sqrt(v[i+1]*v[i+1]+2*S15K_DEC*(S[i+1]-S[i])));
 
 const pc=[];const at=(i,x)=>{const l=S[i+1]-S[i],f=l>0?x/l:0;return[P[i][0]+(P[i+1][0]-P[i][0])*f,P[i][1]+(P[i+1][1]-P[i][1])*f]};
 for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){const l=S[i+1]-S[i];if(l<1e-6)continue;const a=v[i],b=v[i+1],m=(cap[i]<vmax&&cap[i+1]<vmax&&i>0&&i+1<n-1&&l<14)?Math.max(a,b,Math.min(cap[i],cap[i+1])):Math.max(a,b,vmax);
  const x1=Math.max(0,(m*m-a*a)/(2*S15K_ACC)),x2=l-Math.max(0,(m*m-b*b)/(2*S15K_DEC));const br=[];
  if(x1<x2){if(x1>.5)br.push([x1,m]);if(x2<l-.5)br.push([x2,m])}else{const x=Math.max(0,Math.min(l,(b*b-a*a+2*S15K_DEC*l)/(2*(S15K_ACC+S15K_DEC)))),vp=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,a*a+2*S15K_ACC*x));if(x>.5&&x<l-.5)br.push([x,Math.max(a,b,vp)])}
  let px=0,pv=a,pp=P[i];for(const [x,vv] of br.concat([[l,b]])){const q=x>=l?P[i+1]:at(i,x);pc.push({a:pp,b:q,v0:pv,v1:vv,l:x-px});px=x;pv=vv;pp=q}}
 
 const out=[];for(const q of pc){if(q.l<1e-6)continue;const acc=(q.v1*q.v1-q.v0*q.v0)/(2*q.l),o=out[out.length-1];
  if(o&&Math.abs(o.acc-acc)<Math.max(.6,Math.abs(acc)*.04)&&Math.abs(o.v1-q.v0)<.05){o.p.push(q.b);o.v1=q.v1;o.l+=q.l}else out.push({p:[q.a,q.b],v0:q.v0,v1:q.v1,l:q.l,acc})}
 for(const o of out){o.v0=Math.max(.5,o.v0);o.v1=Math.max(.5,o.v1);o.d=2*o.l/(o.v0+o.v1)}return out}

function s15kBuild(v,K){const O=K.orig,out=O.map(g=>Object.assign({},g)),rep=[];

  rep.push([tr.i,tr.j,nl])}

function s15kGap(A,B){const dx=B.x-A.x,dy=B.y-A.y;let g=-1e9;for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const ux=k===0?A.c:k===1?-A.s:k===2?B.c:-B.s,uy=k===0?A.s:k===1?A.c:k===2?B.s:B.c;
  const rA=A.hx*Math.abs(ux*A.c+uy*A.s)+A.hy*Math.abs(-ux*A.s+uy*A.c),rB=B.hx*Math.abs(ux*B.c+uy*B.s)+B.hy*Math.abs(-ux*B.s+uy*B.c),q=Math.abs(dx*ux+dy*uy)-rA-rB;if(q>g)g=q}return g}
function s15kSample(v,legs,N,w0,w1){const T=S15SIM.T,dt=T/N,w={id:v.id,legs},D=s15kDims(v),nc=s15kNC(v),out=new Array(N),lb=nc?80:1,a0=w0==null?N:N+w0-lb,a1=w1==null?2*N:Math.min(2*N,N+w1+1);

 for(let i=(w0==null?0:a0);i<a1;i++){const q=s15PoseAt(w,(((i%N)+N)%N)*dt);let x,y,h=0,f=0;if(q){x=q[0];y=q[1];h=q[2];f=q[4]||0}else{x=px==null?0:px;y=py==null?0:py;f=-1}if(px!=null)acc+=Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);X[i]=x;Y[i]=y;S[i]=acc;H[i]=h;F[i]=f;px=x;py=y}
 let Lc=0,Wc=0,g=0;if(nc){const C=S15GR_CART,PX=S15GR.PX||10,VK=S15GR.VK||1.125;Lc=C.L*PX*VK;Wc=C.W*PX*VK;g=C.gap*PX}
 const i00=w0==null?0:a0,look=s=>{let lo=i00,hi=a1-1;if(s<=S[i00])return[X[i00]-(S[i00]-s)*Math.cos(H[i00]),Y[i00]-(S[i00]-s)*Math.sin(H[i00]),H[i00]];while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(S[m]<=s)lo=m;else hi=m}const l=S[hi]-S[lo],f=l>1e-6?(s-S[lo])/l:0;return[X[lo]+(X[hi]-X[lo])*f,Y[lo]+(Y[hi]-Y[lo])*f,Math.atan2(Y[hi]-Y[lo],X[hi]-X[lo])]};
 for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const k=N+i;if(k<a0||k>=a1||F[k]<0){out[i]=null;continue}const b=[s15kObb(X[k],Y[k],H[k],D[0],D[1])];
  for(let c=0;c<nc;c++){const sm=S[k]-(D[0]/2+g+Lc/2+c*(Lc+g)),a=look(sm+Lc/2),e=look(sm-Lc/2);let th=Math.atan2(a[1]-e[1],a[0]-e[0]);if(!(Math.hypot(a[0]-e[0],a[1]-e[1])>Lc*.5))th=c?b[b.length-1].th:H[k];const o=s15kObb((a[0]+e[0])/2,(a[1]+e[1])/2,th,Lc,Wc);o.th=th;o.cart=1;b.push(o)}
  b[0].th=H[k];out[i]={x:X[k],y:Y[k],f:F[k],mv:k>a0&&Math.hypot(X[k]-X[k-1],Y[k]-Y[k-1])>.05,b,sb:s15kObb(X[k],Y[k],H[k],v.L||40,v.W||22)}}
 return out}

function s15kAcBoxes(N){const T=S15SIM.T,dt=T/N,out=new Array(N);for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const L=[];for(const a of S15SIM.flights){const q=s15PoseAt(a,i*dt);if(!q||(q[3]||0)>30)continue;
   const B=s15Boxes(a,q);L.push({id:a.id,b:B.map(x=>s15kObb(x[0],x[1],x[2],2*x[3],2*x[4])),mv:true})}out[i]=L}return out}
 
function s15kHits(id,Sx,i0,i1,ALL,STAT,AC,m,list){const N=Sx.length;let n=0;

  for(const [oid,So] of ALL){if(oid===id)continue;const b=So[i];if(!b||b.f===16)continue;if(Math.abs(a.x-b.x)>320||Math.abs(a.y-b.y)>320)continue;let g=1e9;for(const p of a.b)for(const q of b.b){const z=s15kGap(p,q);if(z<g)g=z}
   if(g<m){n++;if(list)list.push({t:+(i*S15SIM.T/N).toFixed(1),a:id,b:oid,g:+(g/10).toFixed(2),x:Math.round(a.x),y:Math.round(a.y),park:!a.mv&&!b.mv?1:0})}}
  for(const o of STAT){const q=o.b[0];if(Math.abs(a.x-q.x)>260||Math.abs(a.y-q.y)>260)continue;let g=1e9;for(const p of a.b){const z=s15kGap(p,q);if(z<g)g=z}if(g<m){n++;if(list)list.push({t:+(i*S15SIM.T/N).toFixed(1),a:id,b:o.id,g:+(g/10).toFixed(2),x:Math.round(a.x),y:Math.round(a.y),park:a.mv?0:1,stat:1})}}

function s15kSig(V){return V.map(s15kSig1).join('.')}

function s15kSat(A,H,B){
 let dmin=1e9;const ax=[[A.c,A.s],[-A.s,A.c],[B.c,B.s],[-B.s,B.c],[1,0]];
 for(const [ux,uy] of ax){const rA=A.hx*Math.abs(ux*A.c+uy*A.s)+A.hy*Math.abs(-ux*A.s+uy*A.c),rB=B.hx*Math.abs(ux*B.c+uy*B.s)+B.hy*Math.abs(-ux*B.s+uy*B.c);
  const pa=A.x*ux+A.y*uy,pb=B.x*ux+B.y*uy,e=-H*uy,a0=pa-rA+Math.min(0,e),a1=pa+rA+Math.max(0,e),b0=pb-rB,b1=pb+rB,o=Math.min(a1,b1)-Math.max(a0,b0);if(o<dmin)dmin=o;if(dmin<=0)return dmin}return dmin}

function s16pRound(pts){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){const p=pts[i];if(i===0||i===pts.length-1){out.push(p);continue}const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i+1],d1=Math.hypot(p[0]-a[0],p[1]-a[1]),d2=Math.hypot(b[0]-p[0],b[1]-p[1]);
 const r=Math.min(16,d1/2,d2/2);if(r<2||d1<.1||d2<.1){out.push(p);continue}const s=[p[0]+(a[0]-p[0])*r/d1,p[1]+(a[1]-p[1])*r/d1,p[2]+(a[2]-p[2])*r/d1],e=[p[0]+(b[0]-p[0])*r/d2,p[1]+(b[1]-p[1])*r/d2,p[2]+(b[2]-p[2])*r/d2];
 for(let k=0;k<=6;k++){const t=k/6,m=1-t;out.push([m*m*s[0]+2*m*t*p[0]+t*t*e[0],m*m*s[1]+2*m*t*p[1]+t*t*e[1],s[2]+(e[2]-s[2])*t])}}return out}

function s15jAt(a,tc){const T=S15SIM.T;let s=((tc-a.t0)%T+T)%T;if(a.loop)s=s%a.dur;else if(s>=a.dur)return null;

 let x,y,z,h,act,lk=g.lk,ph=0;
 if(g.k==='d'){[x,y,z]=g.p;h=g.h;act=g.act}else{const d=Math.min(g.L,u*g.L/Math.max(.001,g.dur));let k=1;while(k<g.cuLen.length-1&&g.cuLen[k]<d)k++;const a0=g.P[k-1],b=g.P[k],L=g.cuLen[k]-g.cuLen[k-1]||1,f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(d-g.cuLen[k-1])/L));
  x=a0[0]+(b[0]-a0[0])*f;y=a0[1]+(b[1]-a0[1])*f;z=a0[2]+(b[2]-a0[2])*f;h=Math.atan2(b[1]-a0[1],b[0]-a0[0]);act=g.act==='ride'?'stand':'walk';ph=(d/9)%1}
 let al=1;if(a.fadeIn&&s<a.fadeIn)al=s/a.fadeIn;if(a.fadeOut&&a.dur-s<a.fadeOut)al=Math.min(al,(a.dur-s)/a.fadeOut);
 return{x,y,z:z||0,h,act,lk,ph,al:Math.max(0,al),tool:g.tool,leg:i,s,bag:g.bag}}

 try{const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=8;cv.height=8;const c=cv.getContext('2d'),T=S15SIM.T,cfg=[];
  try{for(const fd of (typeof S15J_L!=='undefined'&&S15J_L.fids)||[]){const [x,y,w,kind,title]=fd,Wb=kind==='gate'?50:kind==='belt'?54:w,Hb=kind==='big'?w*.29:kind==='arr'?w*.34:Wb*.5;cfg.push({id:'J:'+title,Wb,Hb,kind,title})}}catch(e){}

   if(cf.kind==='belt')return{dep:[],arr:R.arr.filter(r=>/P[234]/.test(r.gate)).slice(0,2)};if(cf.kind==='gateB'){const gs=['P1','P2','P3','P4','P5','P6'],gg=gs[Math.min(5,Math.max(0,Math.round((cf.x-6600)/400)))],q=R.dep.find(r=>r.gate===gg);return{dep:q?[q]:[],arr:R.arr.filter(r=>r.gate===gg).slice(0,1)}}return R};
  const want={t:'ltr',f:'ltr',g:'ltr',c:'rtl',s:'rtl'},order='tfcgs';
  const chk=(id,L,Hb)=>{o.boards++;for(const q of L.cells.concat(L.heads||[])){o.cells++;if(q.sh)o.shrunk++;if(q.cut)o.cut++;const ov=q.w-q.mx;o.maxOver=Math.max(o.maxOver,ov);if(ov>.01){o.over++;if(o.issues.length<8)o.issues.push(id+' '+q.k+' "'+q.t+'" '+q.w.toFixed(1)+' > '+q.mx.toFixed(1))}
    const l=q.align==='center'?q.x-q.w/2:q.x-q.w,r=q.align==='center'?q.x+q.w/2:q.x;if(l<q.x0-.01||r>q.x1+.01){o.outBad++;if(o.issues.length<8)o.issues.push(id+' '+q.k+' מחוץ לעמודה')}
    if(want[q.k]&&q.dir!==want[q.k]&&!(q.k==='s'&&L.gate)){o.dirBad++}}

     for(const q of R){if(q.y-q.p/2<q.ry0-.5||q.y+q.p/2>q.ry1+.5)o.rowBad++;if(q.ry1>Hb+.01)o.rowBad++}}}};
  const meas=(q)=>{c.font=q.font;const w=c.measureText(q.t).width;return q.align==='center'?[q.x-w/2,q.x+w/2]:q.align==='right'?[q.x-w,q.x]:[q.x,q.x+w]};
  const chkOld=(id,rec,Wp,Hp)=>{o.boards++;o.oldBoards++;const by={};for(const q of rec){o.cells++;const e=meas(q);q.l=e[0];q.r=e[1];const heb=/[֐-׿]/.test(q.t);if((heb?'rtl':'ltr')!==q.dir)o.dirBad++;
     if(q.l<-.01||q.r>Wp+.01||q.y<0||q.y>Hp){o.outBad++;if(o.issues.length<8)o.issues.push(id+' "'+q.t+'" מחוץ ללוח')}const half=q.y<7.8?'h':(q.l+q.r)/2<Wp/2?'L':'R',k=half+'|'+q.y.toFixed(2);(by[k]=by[k]||[]).push(q)}

  for(const b of S15D.bridges)for(const R of sets){const q=R.dep.find(r=>r.gate===b.stand)||R.arr.find(r=>r.gate===b.stand)||R.dep[0];const G=s15paxGateCells(c,0,0,b,q);chk('gate '+b.stand,{cells:G.cells,heads:[],gate:1},20)}
 }catch(e){o.issues.push('שגיאה: '+String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,160))}
 o.maxOver=+o.maxOver.toFixed(2);o.ok=o.boards>0&&!o.over&&!o.outBad&&!o.dirBad&&!o.orderBad&&!o.rowBad&&!o.issues.some(s=>/שגיאה/.test(s));return o}
